title: Design System: 十二号咖啡 No.12 Coffee

display.purpose: Road name on the door plate; text-indent equals tracking so it centres.
display.source: Self-hosted subset of Noto Serif SC 700/900, assets/fonts/serif-*.woff2

numeral.purpose: The house number on the door plate.
numeral.source: Self-hosted subset of Barlow Semi Condensed 500/600/700, assets/fonts/sign-*.woff2

headline.purpose: H1 shop name on the white signboard.

subtitle.purpose: Board column heads, stop names, notice heads, street signs.

body.purpose: All reading text; ledes capped at 34em.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked pinyin / English on signs and plates.

price.purpose: Prices, hours and numbers, tabular figures.

shadows.name: plate-on-wall
shadows.purpose: Every enamel plate hanging on the wall.

shadows.name: arrow-sign
shadows.purpose: Filter shadow for the clipped arrow sign.

shadows.name: enamel-sheen
shadows.purpose: Gloss overlay painted above every plate face.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global keyboard focus; reads on cobalt, white and wall grounds.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The only easing; all transitions and the swing.

motion.name: swing-once
motion.purpose: Hung plates settle once when 60% visible (IntersectionObserver), never loop.

motion.name: flip
motion.purpose: Two-sided hours sign turning on its hook on tap.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover on nav links, buttons, arrow sign.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables swing, transitions, flip animation and smooth scroll.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Short arrow tip (30px), compact signs and hours.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Fixed hero sizes so all hero plates fit the first viewport; smaller chips.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Nav drops brand block; price board one column.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero, price and visit grids collapse to one column; bean route turns vertical.

grounds.name: brick
grounds.purpose: Street wall: hero and visit sections.

grounds.name: limewash
grounds.purpose: Interior wall: price, beans, room sections.

grounds.name: plaster-loss
grounds.purpose: Fallen plaster exposing brick, bleeding off a section edge behind content.

narrative.overview:
The shop's address is its brand, so the page is the wall the shop hangs on. Every piece of key content is lettered onto a vitreous-enamel plate: a cobalt door plate for the address, white enamel boards for the price list and the address card, a two-sided red/iron hanging sign for live status, a street-sign arrow for the way in. Plates are physical objects: rounded corners, a white inner rule, four slotted screws, chipped edges showing dark iron and rust, and a soft cast shadow on the wall behind them.

The wall itself changes with the visitor's position. Outside (the hero and 怎么来) it is grey-blue 青砖 brick with recessed mortar. Inside (价目 / 豆单 / 店里) it is a limewashed 粉墙 interior whose plaster has fallen away in places to show the same brick beneath, so the two grounds read as one building. Nothing floats on a blank field; every plate hangs on a wall.

Lettering follows real Chinese street signage: a heavy Song face for the characters, a condensed highway-sign gothic for pinyin, numerals and plate codes, and the system CJK sans for anything that is meant to be read rather than seen. Density is low and signage-like; the page is legible on a phone in daylight.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt enamel is the voice; white enamel is the secondary board; signal red appears only for the live open state and "you are here".
Every content block is a plate with an inner rule, or sits on one.
Two wall grounds only: brick for the street, limewash with plaster losses for the interior.
Heavy Song characters with widely tracked Latin sign lettering beside or under them.
Motion is physical and once: plates settle with a pendulum swing; the hours sign flips on its hook.

rules.name: The Live Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red marks only live state or location: open now, today, this stop. It is never decoration and never a second brand color.

rules.name: The Closed Is Iron Rule
rules.body: The hours sign shows signal red when open and dark iron when closed (before opening, after closing, rest day). Do not show a red plate when the shop is closed.

rules.name: The Bilingual Sign Rule
rules.body: A lettered plate pairs Plate Song characters with a smaller tracked Sign Gothic line (pinyin or English) beside or below, as on real street signs. Wide tracking is reserved for this short uppercase Latin line and for display characters; reading text is never tracked.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Sign Gothic Rule
rules.body: Prices, hours, house and stop numbers are set in Sign Gothic with tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Wall Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe a plate hanging on a wall lit from above. Shadows are soft and drop downward. Nothing floats above another plate.

dos: **Do** put every key fact on an enamel plate with its inner rule; choose cobalt for primary, white for secondary boards.
**Do** scale the plate radius, inset and rule together using the four existing steps.
**Do** pair Plate Song characters with a tracked Sign Gothic line on signs, and set all numbers in Sign Gothic with tabular figures.
**Do** use brick for street-facing sections and limewash with plaster losses for interior sections.
**Do** keep the hours sign driven by the live clock: red for open, iron for closed.
**Do** regenerate the font subsets after editing Chinese text, and regenerate wall SVGs from their scripts rather than editing them by hand.
donts: **Don't** use signal red for anything except live state or location.
**Don't** place a plate on a blank background; it always hangs on brick or limewash.
**Don't** track body text or set reading paragraphs in Plate Song.
**Don't** add looping or decorative motion; plates move only as hung objects settling or a sign being turned.
**Don't** add more than one or two chips to a plate, or chip small plates; wear is evidence of age, not texture.
**Don't** fabricate photos, reviews or ratings to fill a plate; demo content stays labelled as demo.
